method: Evaluated world triangles, epsilon-zero BVH, unique unordered pairs. Exclude triangles incident on the same exact rest position (including UV-split copies). seam_incident_pairs additionally counts non-index-adjacent pairs removed by that rule. Region = highest summed bone weight on the three corners. Depth = pair minimum separating translation via triangle SAT, mm, zero for tangency/coplanarity. IDs index master mesh loop_triangles. Feet = minimum world Z per side over foot/toe-dominant vertices.
